blocker_categories.OWNER_ACT: needs an act of the owner (an open owner question, owner acceptance of criteria / a reading, an owner release, the staffing ledger)
blocker_categories.EVIDENCE: needs evidence that does not exist yet (analysis / design definition, sourced data, a registered result, a gate evaluation on registered evidence)

blocker_categories.EXTERNAL_INPUT: needs an input from outside the project record (supplier quotation / data, spacecraft / mission ICD)

answer_effects.RULE_RECORDED: the answer fixes a rule, convention or scope; the owner-decision blocker is removed and the answer names no new input for this row
answer_effects.REQUIRES_EVIDENCE: the answer decides that the value comes from evidence (measurement, quotation, sourced data); the blocker becomes that evidence
answer_effects.REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_INPUT: the answer decides that the value comes from an external input that stays TBD
answer_effects.AUTHORIZES_WORK: the answer authorises / orders work; the output of that work becomes the blocker (an authorisation never advances readiness)
answer_effects.SUPERSEDED_FOR_FLIGHT: the answer is superseded / amended by A9.19 / A9.20 (no C1 flight variant; C1 a ground-only laboratory reference); the blocker is removed for the one flight configuration
answer_effects.CONSTRAINS_NOT_REMOVES: the answer constrains a carried blocker but does not remove it

readiness_rules_v4.rule: precedence VERIFIED > RUNNING > BLOCKED > READY; the first condition that holds sets the state (M16 v2 scheduler rule, accepted by the owner in row 141)

VERIFIED: every governing interface document of the row owner-frozen AND every referenced readiness condition SATISFIED (v2 rule) AND, for a physical row, at least one cited artifact of quantity type 'measured' on the project hardware (docs/EVIDENCE.md) that exists and is not synthetic (A9.6 sec. 16). Framework / software / plan / RFQ / ledger / budget / requirement-matrix entries never count

RUNNING: the single blocking item is worked by a registered lane whose scope produces EVERY missing input; never for an owner decision, a measurement, a coupon test or a vendor quotation (v2 owner_decision_items / non_lane_inputs guards)
BLOCKED: a single named blocking item exists (one-blocker rule, row 141) or contributing blockers remain open, and no registered lane works it
READY: no open blocking item AND a named responsible engineer (row 140); without a named engineer the row stays BLOCKED on M16-V3-Q-01
the ten A9.2 statuses are carried verbatim from the pinned A9.2 decision; this matrix never changes, promotes or turns any of them into PASS
SUPERSEDED_FOR_PRIMARY_LINE (v3 addition): a historical row that is not scheduled

blocking-item selection (PROPOSED, extends the v3 rule): the v3 item is carried unless an A9.6 deliverable implements the named item itself as a framework, in which case the row is re-pointed to the missing inputs of that framework (ids checked TBD at build time)

readiness_rules.rule: state vocabulary, precedence and R-M16V4-01 .. 08 unchanged (M16 v4 derive_state(), reused from the pinned v4 builder)

re-derivation: every v4 blocker (scheduler + contributing) is dispositioned; an owner-question blocker is removed only by an owner answer A9.8 .. A9.21 recorded in state v5 (ANSWERED_BY_A9_* / AMENDED_BY_A9_*; pointer + json / md sha256); every other blocker is re-resolved against the live artifact and stays while open

no readiness advance without determining evidence: a state above the v4 state needs a registered measured artifact on project hardware (docs/EVIDENCE.md 'measured'; MEASURED_REGISTRY); an owner answer that authorises / orders work (AUTHORIZES_WORK) or records a rule never advances readiness
every remaining blocker carries one category (OWNER_ACT / EVIDENCE / HARDWARE_RUN / EXTERNAL_INPUT) and a build-time check that it is still open (fail closed)

one scheduler blocking item per row (owner row 141), chosen among the remaining blockers; an answer that changed the v4 item re-points the row to the first missing input of the answer's path (A9.21 programme order where it applies)
named persons: none in the repository and none fabricated; every scheduled row keeps a NAMED_ENGINEER blocker (PENDING_EVIDENCE: staffing ledger, owner) and READY needs a named engineer (R-M16V4-05)

GNG-ICP-01 (A9.21 ICP_GATE) is a row-18 blocker twice: its criteria (PENDING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE, OWNER_ACT) and its evaluation (NOT_EVALUATED, fail closed, EVIDENCE); LOCK-1 is not reportable while it is not GO

inputs.answers: owner answers A9.8 .. A9.21 via state v5 (answered / amended statuses) and the pinned decision records (A9.17 .. A9.21 items without a state row)
